# transcribe.cpp C ABI

Matched public header from `handy-computer/transcribe.cpp` revision
`f1dcd15858c4bbba87ca97862b4e448b2cf15b8f`, ABI version 0.4.0,
normalized public header hash `98540564cd329b85`.

The macOS arm64 runtime comes from the official `transcribe-cpp-native==0.4.0`
software wheel, SHA256
`3dda6c74f3c38add562beb116afe10bf921685c4a96306b1999f852fcf0a3a08`.
Libraries and their distribution licenses are retained under `lib/` and
`licenses/`. No model weights belong in this directory. Native packaging copies
the libraries into the application's Frameworks directory and signs them before
signing the enclosing application. Intel Granite support is unqualified.
